match_nodes.description: CSA CCM Mapping Methodology: process for mapping the Cloud Controls Matrix to other security frameworks and standards. Defines how CCM controls relate to controls in frameworks like NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, and others.

CSA Incident-to-Control Mapping Methodology: process for analyzing security incidents to identify which controls would have prevented or detected them. Draft methodology — namespace claimed for future development.

CSA Control-to-Capability Mapping Methodology: process for mapping abstract control requirements to concrete product security capabilities. Bridges the gap between 'what must be done' (controls) and 'what can be done' (capabilities). Draft methodology — namespace claimed for future development.
CSA Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) Auditing Guidelines — conformity assessment and audit methodology for evaluating cloud controls under CCM and CSA STAR.

data.notes: Defines the assessment methodology, audit objectives, interview prompts, and evidence artifacts for auditing CCM controls. Per-control audit procedures are keyed 1:1 to CCM control IDs (XXX-NN) and are bundled with secid:control/cloudsecurityalliance.org/ccm; the standalone methodology artifacts are also indexed under secid:reference/cloudsecurityalliance.org/artifacts#ccm-v4-1-auditing-guidelines and #auditors-guidance-document-star-certification-auditing-the-cloud-controls-matrix.

cross_references.note: Audits conformity against the Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM).

match_nodes.description: CSA AI Controls Matrix (AICM) Auditing Guidelines — conformity assessment and audit methodology for evaluating AI security controls under AICM and CSA STAR for AI.

data.notes: Defines the assessment methodology, role-specific audit objectives (Model Provider, Cloud Service Provider, Application Provider, Orchestrated Service Provider, AI Customer), and evidence artifacts for auditing AICM controls. Per-control audit procedures are keyed 1:1 to AICM control IDs (XXX-NN) and are bundled with secid:control/cloudsecurityalliance.org/aicm; the standalone methodology artifacts are also indexed under secid:reference/cloudsecurityalliance.org/artifacts#aicm-implementation-auditing-guidelines-frameworks and #auditors-guidance-document-star-for-ai-certification.

cross_references.note: Audits conformity against the AI Controls Matrix (AICM).
